changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 2.0.33[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]Usenet gets its own page in Settings[/COLOR]
-New Settings > Usenet page, right after Providers, with everything for Usenet from start to finish: your Easynews account, Easynews web search, your Newznab indexers, the search and source list options, how NZBs are played (Easynews, Premiumize, TorBox), the backup providers and the Usenet report.
-Easynews moves there from Accounts (it is your Usenet provider, not a debrid) and Newznab from Providers. Premiumize and TorBox stay in Accounts; only their "play NZBs with" switches are on the Usenet page. Every setting keeps its value, and messages and the provider test now point to Settings > Usenet.
[COLOR fffdb515]Newznab: each indexer searched the way it can[/COLOR]
-luc_kodi reads once a week what each indexer can search by and asks first by the TheTVDB or IMDb id it supports, with all its results in one page (up to 100). If the id brings fewer than 3 releases, it also searches by title, for releases the indexer has not linked to the show or film. Season packs too.
-An indexer is no longer asked by an id it does not support (one search less per film on indexers without IMDb ids), and indexers with TV search turned off get a plain search.
[COLOR fffdb515]Easynews: fuller lists and fewer releases that fail to open[/COLOR]
-The first search now shows as much as a rescrape: the list waits up to 3 seconds (it was 1.5) for the availability check, so most lists open with their EN OK releases, and smart search gives Newznab up to 6 seconds before the list may open without it.
-Releases not checked yet are no longer hidden when most checked ones of a title were removed: they show as EN ?, and if one does not play the next NZB is tried by itself.
-The availability check now reads the first piece of RAR and 7z releases (at most 6 per search). A compressed or encrypted archive, an archive inside another or a Blu-ray disc image (ISO, also inside an archive) is known before the list opens: it is left out, or sent straight to Premiumize or TorBox when they are on.
-Whole Blu-ray discs are also recognised by name when there are tags between COMPLETE and BLU-RAY, while season packs (S01, Season 2, Complete Series) and remuxes are not taken for discs.
-A release that really played is marked EN PLAYED for 7 days and is tried first if another NZB does not start. Releases removed from Easynews are remembered for 7 days instead of 1, and checked again if you change your backup providers. A release already known as removed or not streamable is skipped at once when you pick it.
-Season packs with "Single episodes only" turned off: Easynews now plays the episode you asked for instead of the biggest file of the pack. A pack whose file names are hidden goes to Premiumize or TorBox, or is skipped. Packs show EN PACK in the list.
-Pre-flight no longer calls a Usenet playback slow: luc_kodi's own Usenet engine opens more connections as it plays, so its first second is not its speed, and that reading no longer counts as your line speed.
-Usenet report: archives found compressed or encrypted before the list, and how much of your Easynews plan was used to read archive headers.
